subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Now!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our Exclusive Summer Sale, where you can enjoy up to 50% off on select items! From stylish swimwear to trendy summer dresses, we have everything you need to stay fashionable this season. Don't miss out on this limited-time offer - visit our website or stop by our store today to shop the latest summer trends. Hurry, stocks are limited! Happy shopping! Best regards, The Fashion House Team
